Metadata.title: CLEAN — the sales companion
Metadata.description: CLEAN is a sales companion for account executives and account managers: one place to start the day, relationships made visible, and updates captured without retyping.

Landing.headline: Know what matters today. Walk into every meeting prepared.
Landing.lead: CLEAN is a sales companion for account executives and account managers: one place to start the day, relationships made visible, and updates captured without retyping.

capture.name: Capture
capture.description: Turns meetings, emails and notes into updates you approve in one click.

link.name: Link
link.description: Connects people, accounts, deals and signals, and shows coverage gaps.

engage.name: Engage
engage.description: Prepares every interaction with a brief, questions and a debrief.

analyse.name: Analyse
analyse.description: An honest view of your pipeline: deal health, stalls and forecast with reasons.

negotiate.name: Negotiate
negotiate.description: Close and grow: close plans, renewals and expansion whitespace.

Email.magicIntro: Use this link to sign in. It works once and expires in 15 minutes.
Email.magicFooter: If you did not ask for this email, you can ignore it.
Email.inviteIntro: {inviter} invited you to join {organization} on CLEAN, the sales companion.
Email.inviteFooter: The invitation expires in 7 days. Sign in with the email address it was sent to.

Auth.title: Sign in
Auth.lead: No password needed. We email you a link that signs you in.
Auth.checkBody: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. It expires in 15 minutes.
Auth.error: We could not send the link. Check the address and try again.
Auth.later: Google and Microsoft sign-in will be added later.

Start.title: Choose an organisation
Start.lead: You belong to more than one organisation.

Onboarding.title: Create your organisation
Onboarding.lead: You will be its admin. You can invite your team afterwards.
Onboarding.name: Organisation name
Onboarding.error: Enter a name for your organisation.

Onboarding.profileHelp: Sets the starting stages, qualification criteria and contact rhythms. You can change them later in Settings.

Invite.title: Invitation
Invite.lead: Accept to join this organisation on CLEAN.
Invite.signInFirst: Sign in with the email address the invitation was sent to, then come back to this page.
Invite.invalid: This invitation link is not valid.
Invite.expired: This invitation has expired. Ask your admin for a new one.
Invite.used: This invitation has already been used.
Invite.wrong_email: This invitation was sent to another email address. Sign in with that address.

Today.title: Today
Today.emptyBody: Your ranked actions will appear here as soon as your accounts and deals are in CLEAN.
Today.footer: Ranked by transparent rules from your own data. Each line says why.

Placeholder.body: This screen is being built. It arrives in a coming checkpoint.

Team.title: Team and access
Team.visibilityOn: Teammates and managers can read sellers' records
Team.visibilityFoot: Off by default: each seller's accounts, deals and notes are visible only to them. When on, teammates who share a manager, and their managers, can read them. Nobody but the owner can change them. Admins get no extra access.
Team.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
Team.ownAdmin: You cannot remove your own admin role.
